title: Bifurcate then Alienate: Incomplete Multi-view Clustering via Coupled Distribution Learning with Linear Overhead

layout.note: Four black dashed stage frames in a row (Feature Clusters, Association, Sample Clusters, Results), each titled in bold italic grey at its bottom. Three view lanes (green, pink, purple, with vertical ellipses) run through them left to right, fuse into the grey D, AW and CSC blocks and end in four result cards. Inside Feature Clusters a blue dashed frame holds the shared side and an orange dashed frame the specific side, linked by pairs of ME block arrows.

lesson: Give each view a colour that runs as a lane through every stage and turns grey where the views are fused; frame the stages with dashed rectangles titled at the bottom, and draw incomplete data as bars with dashed gaps.
